tasks.title: Scaffold Flash Up and its CI contract
tasks.outcome: A booting iOS/iPadOS project with the required targets, dependencies, localization shell, and CI wrappers.
grilling_evidence: Approved implementation specification; bundle identifier and CloudKit container naming remain a configuration placeholder.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: The scaffold and later Apple-platform integration work reuse the same Xcode, package, and CI knowledge.
tasks.context: Creates the only supported project shape before production behavior exists.
what_to_do: Create the app, package, test targets, SPM dependencies, capabilities, String Catalog, lint config, CI wrappers, and four-tab placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: B0.1 stop conditions hold on iPhone and iPad simulators.
Architecture brief and worklog are copied into docs.
out_of_scope: Core Data model or feature implementation.

tasks.title: Prove the two-store CloudKit topology
tasks.outcome: ADR-001 establishes whether the specified private/shared-store topology works with the configured CloudKit container.
grilling_evidence: Architecture brief is authoritative; an unexpected CloudKit behavior blocks production persistence.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Store topology, sharing, migration, and sync require recurring CloudKit/Core Data expertise.
tasks.context: This is the first irreversible architecture proof.
what_to_do: Implement only throwaway topology proof code and document all verified options, entitlements, local mode behavior, and gotchas in ADR-001.
acceptance_criteria: All B0.2 verification points are evidenced in ADR-001.
Any required deviation is explicitly escalated.
verification: CloudKit schema initialization and two-store manual proof
out_of_scope: Production Core Data model or ShareManager.

tasks.title: Prove sharing, acceptance, and graph movement
tasks.outcome: ADR-002 proves or amends share acceptance and the UUID-preserving deck move algorithm with two Apple accounts.
grilling_evidence: No production sharing work may begin until ADR-002 resolves the zone-move assumption.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Uses the same CloudKit relationship-graph and manual-account discipline as fu-01.
tasks.context: The shared zone boundary is the highest data-integrity risk in the product.
what_to_do: Extend spike code to share, accept, list participants, leave, move graphs both directions, and record lifecycle hooks in ADR-002.
acceptance_criteria: B0.3 stop conditions and two-account evidence are recorded.

tasks.title: Pin and prove the FSRS adapter contract
tasks.outcome: A pinned swift-fsrs dependency, deterministic FlashUpDomain adapter, and ADR-003 mapping table.
grilling_evidence: The external FSRS API is isolated before schedules persist its representation.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: FSRS, queueing, replay, import codecs, and pure domain tests share deterministic-domain expertise.
tasks.context: Retires third-party API uncertainty without coupling storage to library types.
what_to_do: Pin swift-fsrs, add FSRSService protocol/adapter, prove deterministic replay and interval preview, and write ADR-003.
acceptance_criteria: All B0.4 mapping and determinism requirements are covered by tests and ADR-003.

tasks.title: Build the CloudKit-safe data core
tasks.outcome: The app has a V1 two-store Core Data model, repositories, affinity guarantees, trash/purge lifecycle, and remote-change extension points.
grilling_evidence: ADR-001 controls topology; any contradiction is an ADR, not an implementation choice.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: One owner prevents incompatible model, repository, and sync assumptions across the shared persistence seam.
tasks.context: Combines original data beads because the model's store-affinity and history hooks cannot be honestly verified in isolation.
what_to_do: Add content/study repositories, tag scope, trash/purge, SyncMonitor, remote history processing, and tag dedup hooks.
Add model-lint, affinity, dedup, token-resume, and purge tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every B1.1–B1.4 stop condition holds.
Study objects are asserted private even when a shared store exists.
out_of_scope: Feature screens, production sharing, card reconciliation, schedule replay.

tasks.title: Complete the note lifecycle domain contract
tasks.outcome: Notes parse clozes, fingerprint/tag safely, generate stable cards, reconcile edits, and convert types without losing study history.
grilling_evidence: Card UUID stability and no cross-scope tag merges are frozen contracts.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Pure parsing and persistence reconciliation share the note-domain test fixtures and type boundaries.
tasks.context: A complete note lifecycle avoids five agents rediscovering cloze/card invariants.
what_to_do: Implement ClozeParser, ContentFingerprint, TagNormalizer, CardGenerator/Reconciler, and NoteTypeConverter; wire remote reconciliation and history provider seams.
acceptance_criteria: Every B2.1–B2.5 listed test case passes.
Surviving template keys keep their UUID; removed clozes are soft-deleted.

tasks.title: Build deterministic private study scheduling
tasks.outcome: Private schedules and append-only review logs produce deterministic replay, queues, resumable sessions, undo, and metrics.
grilling_evidence: Review-log ordering and private-store-only invariants are non-negotiable.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: One deterministic event-sourcing owner minimizes adapter and snapshot token overhead.
tasks.context: All five source beads form a causal chain from answer to replay to UI-ready metrics.
what_to_do: Implement schedule persistence, answer logs, replay/dedup, queue limits, session persistence/undo/reset, and metrics cache with full deterministic tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every B3.1–B3.5 stop condition holds.
Shuffled remote log orders converge identically and undo is replay-safe.
out_of_scope: SwiftUI study experience or settings controls.

tasks.title: Deliver portable import, export, and backup services
tasks.outcome: CSV and backup codecs safely import, export, undo, restore, and preserve data without requiring UI.
grilling_evidence: Import atomicity and backup merge behavior are protected data-integrity contracts.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Parsers, codecs, and transactional data tests share the same pure/data boundary.
tasks.context: The UI can use a cohesive portability service instead of separately wiring four transport paths.
what_to_do: Implement RFC 4180 parsing, planner/committer/undo, deck export, BackupCodec, and BackupService integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every B4.1, B4.2, B4.4, and B4.5 stop condition holds.
Import has no partial commit; backup round trip preserves schedules and logs.
out_of_scope: File importer/exporter views and settings UI.

tasks.title: Ship the content-management vertical slice
tasks.outcome: Users can navigate the app, create/edit/search/import/export content, and recover it from trash with accessible localized UI.
grilling_evidence: Editor autosave, Markdown rendering, content privacy, and trash semantics follow the approved spec.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: The navigation shell, Library, import flow, and editor repeatedly use SwiftUI state, accessibility, and localization seams.
tasks.context: One vertical content-management pass eliminates repeated navigation/view-model integration work.
what_to_do: Build AppEnvironment and shell, Library/Deck/Trash/Search views, full note editor/Markdown preview, and file/share import flow with undo.
acceptance_criteria: Every covered source bead stop condition holds.
Create, edit, import, search, trash, restore flow is covered by UI tests.

tasks.title: Ship the study experience
tasks.outcome: Today, statistics, study session, resume, undo, and completion are usable and accessible on iPhone and iPad.
grilling_evidence: FSRS grade captions and session persistence are already frozen by fu-06.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Uses the same SwiftUI navigation, Markdown, localization, and UI-test ownership as the Library batch.
tasks.context: Metrics presentation and study interaction share session state and accessibility work.
what_to_do: Build Today/Statistics, StudySession, completion/resume UI, charts accessibility, keyboard shortcuts, reduced motion, and reminder event hook.
acceptance_criteria: Every B5.2, B5.7, B6.1, and B6.2 stop condition holds.
Seeded session supports different grades, undo, relaunch/resume, and completion.

tasks.title: Complete settings, onboarding, reminders, and support
tasks.outcome: A new user onboards into a studyable demo deck and can control settings, backup, reminders, support, and review prompting.
grilling_evidence: Notifications require opt-in; support diagnostics never contain user content.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: All work is system-facing SwiftUI presentation and application-state wiring.
tasks.context: Settings hosts the four source features and allows one coherent preference/state pass.
what_to_do: Build Settings root/data/sync sections, mandatory onboarding and demo deck, reminder state machine/UI, SupportComposer, and review milestone.
acceptance_criteria: Every B8.1, B8.2, B8.4, and B8.6 stop condition holds.
Backup restore works from UI and onboarding creates a studyable demo deck.
out_of_scope: Group tutorial, delete-all-data flow, release audit.

tasks.title: Connect group owners and members
tasks.outcome: An owner can create/invite and a second Apple account can accept and see a shared group safely.
grilling_evidence: ADR-002 defines the acceptance hook and no-iCloud behavior.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Production sharing must preserve the architecture learned in both CloudKit spikes.
tasks.context: Owner/member connection is a single end-to-end contract and the prerequisite for all group work.
what_to_do: Implement ShareManager, group creation/invite UI, sharing controller wrapper, application acceptance wiring, local-only states, and checklist.
acceptance_criteria: B7.1 and B7.2 stop conditions hold across two accounts.
Revoked/already-member/no-iCloud states are safe and localized.
out_of_scope: Deck movement, group leave/removal, revision history.

tasks.title: Manage group membership and move deck graphs
tasks.outcome: Participants can inspect/leave groups and owners can move or copy deck graphs while private study progress survives.
grilling_evidence: ADR-002 move algorithm and private-study affinity are immutable constraints.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Shared-zone migration must have one CloudKit-focused owner and test fixture family.
tasks.context: Membership operations and movement touch the same share graph and failure-reconciliation logic.
what_to_do: Build GroupDetail leave/remove flows, DeckMover with failure reconciliation, group destination UI, and two-account movement evidence.
acceptance_criteria: B7.3 and B7.4 stop conditions hold.
UUID, tags, revisions, and private schedule continuity follow the source contract.

tasks.title: Complete shared revision and ownership lifecycle
tasks.outcome: Shared edits have restorable revision history and group deletion is safe and understandable for owners and participants.
grilling_evidence: Ownership transfer is not silently invented; owner deletion behavior follows ADR-002.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Revision concurrency, ownership, and zone disappearance are continuations of collaboration lifecycle behavior.
tasks.context: Both source beads are ownership/history semantics at the end of the group lifecycle.
what_to_do: Implement revision recorder/history/restore/pruning wiring, owner deletion UI, participant disappearance state, and manual checklists.
acceptance_criteria: B7.5 and B7.6 stop conditions hold.
Concurrent edit and owner-deletion behavior is documented and safe.
out_of_scope: Delete all user data, final accessibility audit.

tasks.title: Finish contextual guidance and user-data erasure
tasks.outcome: Users can replay contextual help and can erase only their own data through an explicit, backup-first flow.
grilling_evidence: Deletion is ordered, confirmation-gated, and must not harm joined groups owned by others.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: The work is product guidance plus irreversible-flow UI built on established settings and group surfaces.
tasks.context: Both beads are trust-building final product behavior that depends on finished groups/settings.
what_to_do: Build tutorial replay/Help FAQs and the typed-confirmation, backup-offer, ordered deletion flow with onboarding return.
acceptance_criteria: B8.3 and B8.5 stop conditions hold.
Wrong erase confirmation cannot execute; joined groups remain intact for their owners.
out_of_scope: Localization/a11y release audit or App Store submission.

tasks.title: Audit, validate, and submit Flash Up v1
tasks.outcome: The localized, accessible app has documented device/account QA, App Store configuration, TestFlight evidence, and a completed submission.
grilling_evidence: Release decisions require the human Apple Developer account holder and verified production behavior.
tasks.worker_profile_rationale: Release audit is a specialized evidence-and-human-operations role, not feature implementation.
tasks.context: Release criteria cannot be inferred from tests; they are a final manual verification and publication lane.
what_to_do: Complete App Store Connect checklist, localization/a11y audits, device and sharing matrix, TestFlight rounds, metadata, privacy, and submission evidence.
acceptance_criteria: B0.5 and B9.1–B9.3 stop conditions hold.
No release blockers remain and submission is recorded.
out_of_scope: New feature work or silent scope changes.
